//: Every source file including tests, for scripts/typecheck-tests.mjs only (2026-10-09).
tsconfig.test.json checks the harness and explains why the tests are not in it: tsx runs them in a
different module mode, so a plain check reports how they execute rather than whether they are right.
That noise is real (TS1343, TS2306) and the script does not gate on it. What it gates on is narrower and
is not noise: a test calling the code it tests with the wrong arity, a property that does not exist,
or an unknown field — a test that passes while exercising something other than what it names.
